policy.unknown_default: UNRESOLVED families remain private until field, license, and consumer audits approve an allowlist projection.

projection_contract.required_tier_semantics: required_tier is the minimum tier allowed to receive the complete stored key family. Lower-tier projections, where allowed, are separate objects described by safe_public_schema.
projection_contract.ANONYMOUS: Public shell and facts plus approximately one approved current preview item; zero hidden premium remainder.
projection_contract.FREE: Anonymous capabilities plus persistence and approximately three approved preview items; zero paid-only remainder.
projection_contract.ESSENTIAL: Complete standard current operational product, including standard rows, plans, filters, alerts and standard history.
projection_contract.PRO: Essential plus approved advanced indicators, Research Vault/archive, deeper history and export.
projection_contract.PRIVATE_SERVICE: Service principals only; never a browser/customer tier.
projection_contract.OPERATOR_ONLY: Named operator/admin workflows only; never a browser/customer tier.
projection_contract.HOLD_PRIVATE_PENDING_REVIEW: No delivery until field/source/rights classification is resolved.

key_expression_grammar.default_scope: An unprefixed expression is a Cloudflare R2 object-key expression relative to public_r2_base.

scopes.MACRO_GIT_RAW:: A path in the public Macro repository raw origin at source_snapshots.macro.
scopes.TERMINAL_GIT_RAW:: A path in the public mastermind-terminal repository raw origin at source_snapshots.terminal.
scopes.TERMINAL_STATIC:: A path served by the Terminal static origin.
scopes.TERMINAL_CLIENT_BUNDLE:: A tracked Terminal source path compiled into browser-delivered JavaScript.
scopes.PRIMARY_STATIC:: A path served by the primary mastermind-x.com static origin.
scopes.CONFIG:: A runtime configuration state, not an object key.

operators.{a,b}: Finite alternatives at the same path position.
operators.*: Zero or more characters within one path segment.
operators.**: Zero or more complete path segments.
operators.UNION(a,b): The union of two or more fully scoped expressions.
operators.DEFAULT_DENY:x: An ordered fallback for the remainder in x after every positive rule in the same scope. If no positive matches, the first matching DEFAULT_DENY row in families order wins; narrower defaults must precede broader defaults.
